summary: This Dockerfile creates a custom nginx web server image by starting with the official nginx image, installing the openssl cryptography tool, and then copying in SSL certificate files and a custom nginx configuration file. The cleanup step removes package manager caches to keep the image size smaller.

explanations.3: The backslash at the end of the line allows you to continue a single command across multiple lines, making it more readable.
explanations.5: After installing openssl, we delete the package manager's cache files (the /var/lib/apt/lists directory) because we don't need them anymore and they just waste space in our image.
explanations.7: COPY takes files from your local machine (the left path) and puts them into the Docker image (the right path), so your SSL certificate can be used by nginx inside the container.
